# Responsive

Responsive rules preserve task priority instead of scaling desktop geometry down.

## Window strategy

Large desktop uses three panes; desktop uses two panes with optional detail; tablet moves support into a drawer; mobile uses one pane, a route, or a bottom sheet.

## Container first

Components respond to available containers and text scale, not device brands. Keyboard, safe area, RTL, and orientation are layout inputs.

## Reference

See [Adaptive Layout](/en/patterns/adaptive-layout), [Desktop Guide](/en/platforms/desktop), and [Mobile Guide](/en/platforms/mobile).
